A.name: The Harbor Gazette: strike framing

codebook.SYMPATHETIC: Presents the strikers' grievances as legitimate, or strikers as victims or heroes.
codebook.HOSTILE: Presents strikers as criminals, dangerous, ungrateful or manipulated.
codebook.NEUTRAL_REPORT: Reports facts (dates, numbers, events) without evaluative language.
codebook.MERCHANT_COST: Frames the strike mainly through economic harm to trade, ships or the town.

A.brief: A historian transcribed snippets from three newspapers of a fictional port town (1880s). Code how each snippet frames the dockworkers' strike.

codebook.ALTYAPI: Roads, water, sewage, electricity, street works: physical infrastructure problems.
codebook.TEMIZLIK: Garbage collection, litter, dirty public spaces, bulky waste.
codebook.ULASIM: Buses, metro, minibuses, schedules, stops and transport accessibility.
codebook.GURULTU_GUVENLIK: Noise, public safety, lighting at night, stray animals, disorder.
codebook.BELEDIYE_HIZMETI: Quality of municipal service: paperwork, delays, staff behaviour, unanswered petitions.
codebook.DIGER: Praise, personal notices, questions, anything not about a municipal problem.

codebook.HEALTH: Hospitals, doctors, medicines, public health insurance, epidemics.
codebook.EDUCATION: Schools, universities, teachers, curricula, student funding.
codebook.TAXATION: Taxes, duties, tax reform, public revenue and tax fairness.
codebook.DEFENCE: Armed forces, military budget, conscription, national security.
codebook.MIGRATION: Immigration, asylum, border control, integration of newcomers.
codebook.ENVIRONMENT: Pollution, climate, protected areas, energy transition.
codebook.LABOUR: Wages, unions, working hours, unemployment, workplace safety.
codebook.JUSTICE: Courts, police, prisons, criminal law, rule of law.
codebook.AGRICULTURE: Farming, rural subsidies, land use, food production.
codebook.FOREIGN_AFFAIRS: Treaties, diplomacy, trade agreements, relations with other states.
codebook.INFRASTRUCTURE: Roads, railways, ports, housing construction, public works.
codebook.OTHER: Procedural remarks, greetings, anything not fitting the above. If a speech mixes topics, code the one the speaker spends most words on.

codebook.GIFT_EXCHANGE: Goods or services given with an expectation of a later return, between households. Look for baskets, honey, plums, reciprocal sending.
codebook.MARRIAGE_NEGOTIATION: Talks, visits or payments about a proposed or arranged marriage, including bride-gifts and go-betweens.
codebook.ANCESTOR_RITUAL: Offerings, songs or visits addressed to dead kin or the lineage's founders.
codebook.DISPUTE_MEDIATION: A conflict is discussed or settled with the help of an elder or neutral person.
codebook.EVERYDAY_LABOR: Routine work such as herding, weaving, carrying water, tending terraces, with no ceremonial frame.

codebook.TRUST_COMPETENCE: Trusts the local government because it delivers services well or is effective.
codebook.TRUST_PERSONAL: Trusts because of a specific person or personal contact (the mayor, a clerk who helped).
codebook.DISTRUST_CORRUPTION: Distrusts because of bribery, favouritism or misuse of money.
codebook.DISTRUST_INCOMPETENCE: Distrusts because services fail or officials are ineffective.
codebook.NO_OPINION: Says they do not know, do not care, or gives no reason either way.

fields.speaker_role: one of: long_term_resident, newcomer, shop_owner, landlord, other
fields.perceived_change: one of: positive, negative, mixed, none (the speaker's view of how the neighbourhood has changed)
fields.emotion: one of: anger, nostalgia, hope, resignation, pride, none (the dominant emotion)
fields.institution_mentioned: list of strings: institutions named (council, school, police, bank, ...); empty list if none
fields.years_in_neighborhood: integer number of years the speaker has been there, or null if not stated or not computable

codebook.SAFETY: Frames the lanes in terms of accidents, injuries, protection or danger.
codebook.ECONOMY: Frames the lanes in terms of cost, shops, jobs, taxes or business.
codebook.LIFESTYLE: Frames the lanes in terms of culture, habits, health, identity or how people want to live.
codebook.CONSPIRACY: Claims a hidden plan or elite scheme behind the lanes.

codebook.MINOR: Low harm, small value, no injury, minor penalty.
codebook.MODERATE: Material loss or injury, but not life-threatening or large-scale.
codebook.SERIOUS: Serious injury, death, large-scale harm or violence/weapons.
